construct: SLC4A4 encodes NBCe1-A, the electrogenic sodium-bicarbonate cotransporter on the basolateral membrane of proximal tubular cells. Loss impairs basolateral Na+/HCO3- exit and therefore transepithelial bicarbonate reabsorption, causing autosomal recessive proximal renal tubular acidosis often accompanied by ocular abnormalities.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A proximal RTA pattern with preserved distal urine acidification, ocular disease, and biallelic SLC4A4 variants identifies NBCe1 deficiency. NBCe1-A performs basolateral electrogenic sodium-bicarbonate transport in proximal tubular cells.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Apical NHE3 participates in proximal bicarbonate reclamation but is not encoded by SLC4A4; alpha-intercalated-cell proton secretion and AE1 exchange are distal acidification processes, while pendrin is a beta-intercalated-cell exchanger.
adversarial_second_pass.expert_reviewer_reversal: The SLC4A4 genotype and proximal-versus-distal physiology independently converge on basolateral NBCe1 transport, leaving no alternative transport option defensible.
